name: Sefa
look: A tall, serene woman in her sixties with long silver hair loose down her back, a white wool robe with a blue-dyed hem, a necklace of lake pebbles and bare feet.
personality: Serene, curious and devout; sees the Lady of the Lake's hand in every wonder, and is moved by it rather than frightened.
values: the Lady of the Lake, wonder, kindness to the poor
fears: the Lady's anger, the shrine forgotten
authority: Keeps the shrine of the Lady of the Lake.
concerns: The shrine's lamp went out in last night's wind and she has no flint: the fire must be lit anew.

lamp.text: The shrine lamp must be lit with new fire, and she has no flint.
lamp.line: The Lady's lamp went out. New fire, it must be, and I have no flint.
lamp.lead: Sefa needs new fire to light the shrine's lamp.

stone.text: The black stone on the altar pulls iron to it: a gift of the Lady, they say.
stone.line: That black stone? It draws iron to itself. The Lady's gift, the old ones said.
stone.lead: The black stone in Sefa's shrine draws iron to it.

style: Slow and warm; speaks of the Lady as of a neighbour.

samples: The Lady sends us wonders, if we've eyes for them.
Brann sees witches under every stone, poor man.
voice.habits: Touches her pebble necklace; blesses people; asks how things work, then answers herself.
voice.greeting: Smiles: 'Welcome to the Lady's shore, traveller.'

goals: Relight the shrine lamp with new fire

npc_brann_fisher.text: a good man, too quick to fear

superstition.text: Sefa sees the Lady of the Lake's hand in every wonder, and calls it a blessing.
